title: Halting return step
statement: For every Boolean $b$, input-head position $ip$ on a fixed input word $y$, and natural number $v$, one step of the doubled-input machine from the configuration in state yes when $b$ is true and no when $b$ is false, with work tape storing the binary word for $v$ and its head at $0$, reaches a halting configuration. Its output is the one-symbol word $[b]$, and its work-tape head remains at $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $ip$ is a valid input-head position for $y$
